# The Wall That Didn't Fall

In the fall of 1989, crowds gathered at the border. The wall didn't fall that night, and nobody was killed.

## The Money

The city spent $2.5 million on new gates. A guard said he was paid 20 dollar bills a week. By 1990, more than 45 percent of the guards had quit.

## The Baby

A baby was born at the checkpoint on November 9, 1989. Her mother walked across with her the next morning.

## Why It Mattered

Historians still argue about what happened. The best way to remember is to visit the site. It was a quiet end.
